subject: QuantumArc renewal: capacity uplift, commit concession, and price-hold counter
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@quantumarc.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: capacity bump & price protection request

Hi Naomi,

Hope you are well — QuantumArc has had a great Q1 using Redwood (especially the new KV caching improvements). We're beginning our renewal conversation and I wanted to get a sense of options you can offer around two items that are critical for us:

1) A 15–20% uplift in committed capacity for the next 12 months (we expect steady growth from a new customer segment).
2) Price protection (a hold) for the first 3–4 months of the new term while we validate usage patterns post-launch.

Two asks on your side: can you outline a commercial that includes a short-term price hold and some kind of credit mechanism for unused committed capacity (we prefer amortized credits vs. one-off refunds), and whether a small burst pool can be included for short spikes?

I've attached our Q1 usage export to help sizing. Samir (copied) is our head of platform and will shepherd final numbers. We'd like to close terms by May 12 if possible.

Thanks —
Elena Ruiz
VP, Platform — QuantumArc
elena@quantumarc.com
Attachment: quantumarc_usage_q1.csv (CSV, 42 KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@quantumarc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: capacity bump & price protection request

Hi Elena — great to hear the KV caching lift is working for you. Thanks for the usage file — that helps. High level response below, plus I looped in Ben (AE) and Marcus (finance) to validate numbers.

We can do a commercially-sound path that balances your validation needs and our cost plan. Two pragmatic options for you to consider:

Option A (recommended for predictability)
- 12-month term, commit uplift +20% vs current run-rate
- 10% list discount applied to committed units
- 90-day price-hold from contract effective date (no price increases during this window)
- Unused-commit credits: up to 20% of committed spend allowed to convert to credits over the first 6 months (amortized monthly)
- Included burst pool: 15% extra capacity for short spikes (billed at committed rates up to cap)

Option B (lower upfront lift)
- 12-month term, commit uplift +10%
- 6% list discount
- 120-day price-hold
- Smaller burst pool (10%) and credits capped at 10% of committed spend

If you want, we can meet tomorrow for 30 minutes to walk numbers. Ben — can you confirm whether the 20% uplift + 10% discount keeps us within our standard renewal thresholds or whether we need a discount exception? Marcus — I attached a draft term sheet (QARC_DRAFT_TERM_SHEET_v1.pdf) with the Option A figures.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Accounts, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
Attachment: QARC_DRAFT_TERM_SHEET_v1.pdf
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@quantumarc.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@quantumarc.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: capacity bump & price protection request

Naomi — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear options. Option A looks closest to what we want, but two requests from our side:

1) Can you drop the commit uplift to +10% (we're confident in growth but prefer a smaller upfront financial change)?
2) We need a 120-day price hold to align with our launch validation window.

If you can accept +10% uplift + 120-day hold, we'll sign quickly. Also please include the amortized credit language you mentioned — we prefer credits to apply against overage first, then towards next term.

Samir and I are available for a quick sync midday tomorrow if you want to talk through wording.

Regards,
Elena
Attachment: none
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: QuantumArc renewal: capacity bump & price protection request

Forwarding Elena's note — she pushed back on the +20% uplift. Quick internal ask: are we comfortable with 10% uplift + 120-day hold if we trade for a 10% discount and a $75k bridge credit amortized over the first 6 months?

On margin: Marcus, can you run a quick delta showing expected gross margin impact (best/worst) and include any approval thresholds we hit? Jordan — wanted to flag since this looks like an up-market renewal with potential for Dedicated later.

Thanks,
Ben

--- Forwarded message ---
On 2027-05-03 08:20, Elena Ruiz wrote:
> Naomi — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear options. Option A looks closest to what we want...
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: QuantumArc renewal: capacity bump & price protection request

Ben/Naomi/Jordan — attached is a simple margin calc (margin_calc_qarc.xlsx) that models three scenarios:

1) +20% uplift / 10% discount / 90-day hold — midpoint margin ~ 46%
2) +10% uplift / 10% discount / 120-day hold — midpoint margin ~ 40%
3) +15% uplift / 10% discount / 120-day hold — midpoint margin ~ 43%

Given the renewal value and runway to upsell Dedicated next year, I recommend the +15% uplift with a 10% discount and a 120-day hold. We still stay inside approval thresholds and this preserves room for additional add-ons.

Marcus Lin
Finance — Redwood Inference
Attachment: margin_calc_qarc.xlsx
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@quantumarc.com>, Samir Patel <samir@quantumarc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Final counter: QuantumArc renewal commercial sweetener

Elena / Samir — thanks for the patience while we ran scenarios internally. Below is our final commercial we can commit to today if QuantumArc confirms by May 10: 

Final commercial (counter-offer) — must confirm by 2027-05-10
- Term: 12 months effective on signature
- Commit uplift: +15% over current committed units
- Discount: 10% off list on committed units
- Price-hold: 120 days from effective date (no list increases within this window)
- Bridge credit: $75,000 applied as amortized credits across the first 6 invoice cycles (applies against overage first, then next term)
- Burst pool: 10% extra burst capacity included (soft cap; excess billed at committed rate)
- Next steps: we will push the revised term sheet (QARC_FINAL_TERM_SHEET_v2.pdf) to DocuSign after you confirm.

If this sounds good I will route the DocuSign link and Ben will coordinate invoicing. Happy to hop on a short call if you want final language tweaks.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Accounts, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
Attachments: QARC_FINAL_TERM_SHEET_v2.pdf
